title: Small balances, hardship eligibility and credit refunds on the Urology and Continence Supply Program
content:
On the Urology and Continence Supply Program, Larkfield's patient financial terms set four figures for each tier: the small-balance write-off ceiling, whether a hardship waiver is available, the household income ceiling for that waiver, and the time limit for refunding a credit balance.

## Terms

- **Small-balance write-off ceiling**: the largest remaining patient balance, in USD, that is written off as a small balance instead of being statemented. A figure of 0.00 USD means the tier has no small-balance write-off.
- **Hardship waiver available**: whether a documented financial-hardship waiver of patient cost share may be granted case by case on the tier.
- **Hardship income ceiling**: the household income ceiling for a financial-hardship waiver. It is a whole percent of the current HHS federal poverty guideline for the household size.
- **Credit refund limit**: the time limit for refunding a customer credit balance, which is an overpayment. It is counted in calendar days from the posting date of the entry that created the credit.

## Schedule

| Basis | Continence Self-Pay Program | Continence Commercial HMO Program | Continence Commercial PPO Program | Continence Medicare Advantage Program | Continence Original Medicare Program | Continence Medicaid Program |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Small-balance write-off ceiling | 0.00 USD | 4.99 USD | 4.99 USD | 4.99 USD | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD |
| Hardship waiver available | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | No |
| Hardship income ceiling (percent of HHS poverty guideline) | 200 percent | 200 percent | 200 percent | 200 percent | 200 percent | 200 percent |
| Credit refund limit (days from the creating posting) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 60 | 60 | 60 |


## Points of reading

- A ceiling of 4.99 USD covers a remaining balance up to and including 4.99 USD. A tier showing 0.00 USD statements every balance.
- The hardship income ceiling is shown for every tier. On a tier where the waiver is not available, a household under the ceiling still receives no waiver.
- **Hypothetical case:** a credit balance created by a payment posted on day 0 of a tier with a 60-day limit is refunded no later than day 60.
